answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 25499 Country: Pakistan Title: Hazrat i want to ask that is one can offer 1 rakat of wetar in isha prayer. because someone told me that hazrat muawiya R.A. often offer 1 rakat of wetar in isha prayer. Question: Aslam-o-Alikum, Hazrat i want to ask that is one can offer 1 rakat of wetar in isha prayer. because someone told me that hazrat muawiya R.A. often offer 1 rakat of wetar in isha prayer. JAZAK ALLAH KAHIR Answer ID: 25499 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1440/1440/M=1431) According to Ahnaf, witr salah is of three rakats with one salam; hence it is not lawful for a hanafi to offer witr of one rakat. In which book the story of Hadhrat Muavia (رضى الله عنه) is mentioned, please quote the complete detail with references. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
